novelty_review.scope: Internal current implementation and literature comparison. Official acceptance is determined by reviewers.
novelty_review.rationale: The redesigned task balances a freely pivoted loaded service arm by changing the counterweight moment, then pins the sliding weight against drift. The robot must support the arm during adjustment and leave it balanced after release.
novelty_review.risk: Moderate overlap in balancing. Correct behavior must come from gravitational moments and the free pin rather than a hidden centering actuator.

review_notes: The evaluated implementation passed native physics, robot control, independent experts and a genuine Dream-1 trial. Public media were decoded and actual sampled images inspected. Current comparisons disclose shared balancing principles and explain the free-equilibrium and pin-retention contribution.

official_review.reason: Importance: no identified equipment and regular core work.
replacement_requirements: Select an actual apparatus and documented service operation before adapting the counterbalance mechanics.
Map every essential load, retaining interface and reset operation to the real procedure.
Support importance with evidence of the actual activity, not broad occupation labels.
